FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A11
A learner aged 15 needs a companion who is a licensed Alabama driver aged 21 or older or a driving instructor, while after the sixteenth birthday any licensed driver may ride beside them. [A11]
Why it matters: group_hint learner-companion; prereq_hint sec01-F29; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F30, sec01-F31.
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A12
A learner license earned at 16 or older needs only a licensed driver beside you, unlike the stricter companion rule that applies before age 16. [A12]
Why it matters: group_hint learner-companion; prereq_hint sec01-F32; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-R01, sec01-F32.
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A11
The learner license issued at 15 stays valid for four years and may be renewed only one time. [A11]
Why it matters: group_hint license-validity; prereq_hint sec01-F29; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F31, sec01-F35.
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A12
Removing the Y restriction after the road test does not start a new term: the regular license runs only for the remainder of the original four-year period. [A12]
Why it matters: group_hint license-validity; prereq_hint sec01-F34; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F35, sec01-R03.
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A12
Drivers aged 16 to under 18 must hold the learner license for six months or until turning 18 before taking the road test. [A12]
Why it matters: group_hint road-test-gate; prereq_hint sec01-F32; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F34.
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A07
A new resident may drive on the old state's license for 30 days, which is a different window from the 90-day yearly limit for visitors from countries that do not license drivers. [A07]
Why it matters: group_hint license-exemptions; prereq_hint sec01-F01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F05, sec01-F06.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A07
An expired Alabama license triggers a new exam after more than three years, but an expired out-of-state license triggers one after more than one year. [A07]
Why it matters: group_hint re-examination-cutoffs; prereq_hint sec01-F01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F02.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A08
The two-document identification path needs at least one photo document, while the three-document path may be all non-photo, and both need one Primary Listing item. [A08]
Why it matters: group_hint identification; prereq_hint sec01-F11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F12, sec01-F13.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A12
Class D with a Y restriction is the car learner license, whereas Class M with a B restriction is limited to motor driven cycles for riders aged 14 or 15. [A12]
Why it matters: group_hint license-classes; prereq_hint sec01-F29; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F36, sec01-F37.
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A08
The minimum licensing age is 16, but the separate under-19 rule ties licensing to school graduation or attendance under Act 93-368. [A08]
Why it matters: group_hint licensing-eligibility; prereq_hint sec01-F08; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F08, sec01-F10.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0008]
